title: ttf-emu pipeline parameters
description: Full-Length 16S Profiling (Emu) for TreeTopFlow. Research use only. Not for clinical or diagnostic use.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output files.

input.description: Path to comma-separated samplesheet with columns sample,fastq_1. Optional fastq_2 is accepted for schema uniformity and ignored (single-end ONT / PacBio HiFi 16S).
input.help_text: The samplesheet must have a header row. Each row is one long-read 16S sample. fastq_2 may be present and empty.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved. You can use an S3 path with the awsbatch profile.

metadata.description: Optional sample metadata TSV. The first column must be ID or sample and match samplesheet sample IDs. Used as phyloseq sample_data and published as sample_metadata.tsv.
metadata.help_text: Leave unset to build phyloseq without sample metadata.

reference_options.title: Reference databases
reference_options.description: Emu 16S database. Default is the unpacked S3 prefix mirrored at refdb.treetopunder.com.

emu_db.description: Emu database directory or .tar/.tar.gz archive. Default is the unpacked default 16S prefix (species_taxid.fasta, taxonomy.tsv). HTTPS mirror: https://refdb.treetopunder.com/emu/default/
emu_db.help_text: Pass an unpacked directory (local, s3://, with or without a trailing slash) or a tar/tar.gz archive unpacked with nf-core/untar. Unpacked directories skip UNTAR.

analysis_options.title: Analysis options
analysis_options.description: Read filtering, Emu abundance cutoff, and optional reports.

skip_chopper.description: Skip Chopper length/quality filtering and send raw reads directly to Emu.

min_quality.description: Chopper --quality minimum average read quality. Default 10.
